excerpt: Taken together, these facts set the shape of this guide: routes rather than rules, each route with its gates, and a dated record of what changed, so that a reader can tell current law from deviation from proposal.
Taken together, the rules below describe a sequence: an agency plans a purchase, forecasts it, researches the market, and only then picks a buying method [1323] [579] [1324].
Taken together, the civilian texts read here show no set of pathways comparable to the AAF; the FAR's parts do that work.
Taken together, small-business entry is explicit in only a few of these texts: the Major Capability and Services instructions, the Middle Tier overview page, the strategy, and FAR Parts 13 and 19.
Taken together, the uncapped phase is where the programs can be worth most to a firm, yet GAO's 2025 report found Phase III data "not reliable enough" to measure it [5][242].

A small firm can do federal work without holding a federal contract. Taken together, the rules below show each form answering three questions differently: who counts as small, who does the work, who gets paid when.
